queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Newline-separated Spanish company legal names. Used when companies is empty. Compatible with the previous Actor.
queries.prefill:
Albrok Mediacion S.A.
Otra Empresa S.L.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Structured company list. When provided, takes priority over queries.

source_id.title: Source ID
source_id.description: External identifier from the source CRM or system.

city.title: City
city.description: City hint used for scoring and disambiguation.

province.title: Province
province.description: Province hint used for scoring and disambiguation.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country hint. Defaults to España when omitted.

apify_token.title: Apify token
apify_token.description: Optional fallback Apify API token. Prefer APIFY_TOKEN environment variable. Never logged.

google_actor_id.title: Google Actor ID
google_actor_id.description: Apify Actor used for Google Search. Default: apify/google-search-scraper.

google_results_per_page.title: Google results per page
google_results_per_page.description: Number of organic results requested per Google query.

max_harvest_candidates.title: Max Harvest candidates
max_harvest_candidates.description: Maximum LinkedIn candidates enriched with HarvestAPI per company (1-3 recommended).

harvest_api_key.title: Harvest API key
harvest_api_key.description: Optional fallback HarvestAPI key. Prefer HARVEST_API_KEY environment variable. Never logged.

fallback_google_by_website.title: Fallback Google by website
fallback_google_by_website.description: If confidence is low, run a third Google query: site:linkedin.com/company "domain.com".

fallback_confidence_threshold.title: Fallback confidence threshold
fallback_confidence_threshold.description: Run domain fallback Google search when selected confidence is below this value.

use_ai_for_ambiguous.title: Use AI for ambiguous cases
use_ai_for_ambiguous.description: Optionally ask OpenAI to choose among ambiguous candidates. Deterministic scoring remains primary.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Optional fallback OpenAI key. Prefer OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable. Never logged.

openai_model.title: OpenAI model
openai_model.description: Model used when AI disambiguation is enabled.

ai_confidence_threshold.title: AI confidence threshold
ai_confidence_threshold.description: Invoke AI only when deterministic confidence is below this value.

batch_size.title: Batch size
batch_size.description: Maximum number of Google queries grouped into a single remote Actor run.

validate_websites.title: Validate websites by homepage fetch
validate_websites.description: Fetch top website candidate homepages (HTTP GET, no paid API) and re-rank/reject pages that do not mention the company. Cheap and recommended.

max_website_probes.title: Max website homepage probes
max_website_probes.description: How many top website candidates to fetch for homepage validation.

fallback_google_maps.title: Google Maps fallback
fallback_google_maps.description: When Google Search finds no usable website, query Google Maps places as a last resort (costs one Maps Actor run per such company).

google_maps_actor_id.title: Google Maps Actor ID
google_maps_actor_id.description: Apify Actor used for Maps fallback. Default: compass/crawler-google-places.

google_maps_max_places.title: Max Maps places
google_maps_max_places.description: Maximum places to crawl per Maps fallback search.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: When true, include candidates, website_candidates, ai_decision and raw_harvest in the output row.
